name: Danganronpa Split
source:
A group of 10 elite high school students is gathered at a very special, high-class high school. To graduate from this high school essentially means you'll succeed in life, but graduating is very difficult. The school is presided over by a Pink and Blue teddy bear called Akiokuma, and he explains to them that their graduation hinges on committing a murder. The only way to graduate is to kill one of your classmates and get away with it. If the other classmates discover the identity of the killer, the killer is the only one executed. However, if they fail to catch the killer, only the killer graduates, and the others are annihilated. Which of the 10 will survive the bloodbath to come?

[From [url=https://thisisarandomfandom.itch.io/danganronpa-split-demo]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一群10名精英高中生聚集在一所非常特殊的高级高中。从这所高中毕业本质上意味着你将在生活中取得成功，但毕业是非常困难的。学校由一只名叫秋熊的粉红相间的泰迪熊主持，他向他们解释说，他们的毕业取决于犯下谋杀罪。毕业的唯一方法就是杀死你的一名同学并逃脱惩罚。如果其他同学发现了凶手的身份，那么凶手就是唯一被处决的人。然而，如果他们没能抓住凶手，那么只有凶手毕业，其他人都被消灭。这10个人中谁能在即将到来的血战中幸存下来？

[来自[url=https://thisisarandomfandom.itch.io/danganronpa-split-demo]itch.io[/url]]
